```yaml
name: Release Please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release-please:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: google-github-actions/release-please-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: python
          package-name: atak-maps
          version-file: setup.py
          changelog-types: |
            {
              "feat": "Features",
              "fix": "Bug Fixes",
              "docs": "Documentation",
              "style": "Styles",
              "refactor": "Refactoring",
              "perf": "Performance Improvements",
              "test": "Tests"
            }
          
      - name: Run XML check
        run: |
          find . -name '*.xml' | wc -l

      - name: Run test check
        run: |
          echo "No tests present" && true
```
